easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Flicker of Fate.
description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Flicker of Fate, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Flicker of Fate, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
